_about: LOCKON v1 (LockSwitch.cs, zones only). enabled=false or file missing = no switch. keys.next / keys.prev = Unity KeyCode names (Mouse3 / Mouse4 = side buttons); pad.next / pad.prev = JoystickButtonN names (empty: LB / RB / R3 are taken by DirectionalInput and the lock toggle; a Dom decision). These keys are not in the Controls menu (no InputMap row yet). classes = switch priority, higher first; ids = exact zone creature ids, prefixes = id starts-with; anything else gets otherPriority; priority <= 0 or a name starting with ignoreNamePrefixes is never a target (ambient animals and mounts are not DuelFighters and never reach the list anyway). order = priority (class, then distance) or angle (screen left to right). wrap = last -> first. rangeM must be <= camera_pose.json zone.targetMaxGapM (9), else CamZone drops the target again. releaseMul = pin kept to rangeM * releaseMul. pinSeconds 0 = the pick stays until the target dies / stops fighting / leaves. cooldownS = min seconds between two presses. autoBossFirst true = the AUTOMATIC pick (ZoneRuntime.Retarget) prefers the higher class over the nearer one (default false = nearest, unchanged). harness = -lockswitchproof defaults.
